summary: Iteration 23: Tested Misal-level filtering dropdown on the Vasuli (Collection Sheet) page. All 10 feature test cases PASS. Filter works correctly client-side with no backend changes needed.

issues: Minor: 'Remaining' count = totalRows - collected (includes both overdue and pending). Summary shows '52 Overdue + 66 Remaining' separately, but they overlap (overdue rows are ALSO part of remaining). This could confuse users into thinking total = 52+66=118 when it's actually 67 total rows. Existing behavior, not new to this feature.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 23: Misal filter feature on /collections page fully tested. Key points: (1) Misal filter only shows when allMisals.length > 1 — requires 'All Illakas' or a multi-Misal Illaka; Rampur Testing has only 1 Misal and correctly hides the filter. (2) With 'All Illakas' selected, 9 Misals across 6 illakas are shown. (3) Filter is purely client-side — no new API calls. (4) All three action modals (Collect/Note/Edit) work on filtered rows. (5) Summary bar (FY strip stats + active month stats) updates correctly. (6) Filter resets on Illaka change (component remount) and FY change (useEffect). The collection sheet URL is /collections (plural).
